unsupported: American Steel Fabrication was founded in 1994 by Tim Thomas and a group of his customers in Pevely, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis.
The client base includes general contractors, subcontractors, and owners such as utility provider Ameren.

Known for: Same-day pickup and next-day delivery for stock items; Complete in-house fabrication facility for structural and reinforcing steel; Locally owned with hands-on management by founder Tim Thomas; Over 30 years of experience serving the Midwest construction market; Premier member of the American Subcontractors Association, Midwest Council
